https://docs.r4photobiology.info/ggpmisc/articles/major-axis-regression.html

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpmisc)

species_colors <- c(
  "Pouteria torta" = "orange",
  "Clarisia  racemosa" = "gold",
  "Alchornea lojaensis" = "green",
  "Myrcia sp nov" = "darkgreen",
  "Hedyosmun  purpurascens" = "purple",
  "Weinmania  loxensis" = "blue"
)

old_theme <- theme_set(theme_bw())

ggplot(data, aes(Narea, `iWUE (μmol/mol)`, colour = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_ma_line(method = "SMA") +
  stat_ma_eq(
    method = "SMA",
    mapping = use_label("eq", "R2", "n", "P")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~elevation_m, nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = species_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Narea",
    y = "iWUE (μmol/mol)",
    colour = "name"
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )
```
```{r SLA}

species_colors <- c(
  "Pouteria torta" = "orange",
  "Clarisia  racemosa" = "gold",
  "Alchornea lojaensis" = "green",
  "Myrcia sp nov" = "darkgreen",
  "Hedyosmun  purpurascens" = "purple",
  "Weinmania  loxensis" = "blue"
)

old_theme <- theme_set(theme_bw())

ggplot(data, aes(`Specific leaf area (cm²/g)`, `iWUE (μmol/mol)`, colour = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_ma_line(method = "SMA") +
  stat_ma_eq(
    method = "SMA",
    mapping = use_label("eq", "R2", "n", "P"),
    label.x.npc = 0.05,       # esquina izquierda
  label.y.npc = 0.95,       # esquina superior
  hjust = 0,                # alinear texto a la izquierda
  vjust = 1,                # alinear arriba
  label.padding = unit(0.05, "lines"),  # menos espacio entre líneas
  lineheight = 0.9          # compactar líneas
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~elevation_m, nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = species_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "SLA",
    y = "iWUE (μmol/mol)",
    colour = "name"
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )
```
